observed_behavior: An approved V3 sprint with validated, unreviewed tasklets could not receive an idle campaign worker because implementation dispatch required tasklets_reviewed first.
expected_behavior: An original idle campaign worker can be assigned to perform authenticated tasklet review without receiving product implementation authority.
causal_mechanism: The only worker dispatch selector required nonempty implementation-runnable tasklets, while the executing worker was the actor required to review those tasklets before they became runnable.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A prerequisite operation depended on the eligibility predicate that the operation itself was responsible for satisfying.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: No worker can pass the implementation dispatch gate to perform the preceding review, leaving an otherwise approved sprint unable to progress.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Review assignment and implementation assignment have distinct eligibility and authority; the latter still requires completed review and runnable tasklets.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: A review-only selector and typed same-campaign reuse action permit the original worker to complete review without asserting product execution readiness.

applicability_conditions: A V3 sprint has approved planning, pending execution, incomplete tasklet review, and a nonempty validated tasklet graph.
A safe idle pair originally created for the campaign is available.
known_non_matches: Planning-only STUB sprints need a separate planning assignment contract.
A reviewed sprint with no runnable tasklets remains ineligible for implementation dispatch.
confirmation_evidence: The live GWEN graph contained an approved reviewable sprint absent from the runnable tasklet selector.
The focused review-only scheduling test produced a typed action while the ordinary runnable selector remained empty.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: review-only scheduling reuses one original idle pair without making unreviewed tasklets executable
tests/ready-sprints.test.js: reviewable selection finds only an approved unreviewed V3 sprint with completed dependencies
